2577-3967-7084-8345.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-3967-7084-8345.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

751-1879-6006.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3263-5330-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-5330-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-5330-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

4613-4687-4734.easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Cradle Clearcutter has a +1/+1 counter on it.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7825.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bifur.
When Bifur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Bifur enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2511-6972-7825.notes: If you have an enduring story, Bifur will trigger twice, and the other counter can be placed on whatever creature you desire.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1843-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
1843-3259-4068.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-3259-6965.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-3259-6965.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4496-5220-6900-7286.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing itself.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-4373-5434.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4373-5434.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

215-3464-4734.description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cradle Clearcutter.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4002-4067-6281-7206.easyPrerequisites:
You control three or more lands that share a name.
You control three or more creatures.
4002-4067-6281-7206.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Dundoolin Weaver.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Dundoolin Weaver that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Dundoolin Weaver token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dundoolin Weaver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat.

104-2557-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-2557-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

1510-2981-4574-5849.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

147-2292-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.

282-3398-6870.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger, Fire Lord Ozai or Delina.
You control another nonlegendary creature that has base power 7 or greater.
282-3398-6870.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger, Delina and Fire Lord Ozai as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of a nonlegendary creature with base power 7 or greater.
Resolve the Fire Lord Ozai trigger, causing you to sacrifice a token made in step 2 and add an amount of {R} equal to the token's power.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

339-677-4068-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
339-677-4068-5147.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

789-2292-2399--129.easyPrerequisites: Gutter Grime has slime counters on it at least equal to the toughness of the creature card in your hand.
789-2292-2399--129.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying {0}.
Either that creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, or activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing that creature.
Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Ooze.
When the Ooze dies, Colfenor triggers, returning the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer abilities, scrying 1 each time.
Repeat.
789-2292-2399--129.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

1168-1651-5542-5967-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-5542-5967-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-5542-5967-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Delney, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

643-4508-5880-6753.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1580-4050-4619.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 white Spirit creature token
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat

772-3967-6553.easyPrerequisites: Shade's Form attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
772-3967-6553.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2452-2577-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Gravecrawler enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat.

2928-3765-6102.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
2928-3765-6102.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
2928-3765-6102.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 1, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

1170-2397-2733-4826-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

372-673-4823.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Planar Incision exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Timeless Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
372-673-4823.description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1309-2061-2103.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
1309-2061-2103.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3293-3967-5282.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
3293-3967-5282.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Wormfang Newt.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1753-3259-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
1753-3259-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

969-3259-5359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2792-3089-4115.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
You have no other Whales on the battlefield or in your graveyard.
2792-3089-4115.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
The token Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
The nontoken Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing the Great Whale token, returning the nontoken Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-4499-4685.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Prosperous Pirates.
Prosperous Pirates enters the battlefield, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1525-3063-3819-4826.notablePrerequisites:
Archelos is untapped.
You have at least ten Gates with different names on the battlefield, in hand and/or in library.
You have a land card in hand.
1525-3063-3819-4826.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Cultivator Colossus enters the battlefield, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos, then revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, putting it in your hand and the rest of the revealed cards on the bottom of your library in any order.
Repeat this process, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat step 3 until you have Maze's End and ten Gates with different names on the battlefield.
Activate three of the Gates by tapping them, adding {3}.
Activate Maze's End's second ability by paying {3}, tapping it and returning Maze's End to your hand, causing you to win the game.

215-527-1909-4852.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala and Elvish Mystic do not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-1909-4852.description:
Activate Elvish Mystic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning Elvish Mystic to your hand, untapping Selvala.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Symbiote to your hand.
Cast Elvish Mystic by paying {G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat from step 2.

570-1764-2024.notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
570-1764-2024.description:
Activate Scrapbasket by paying {1}, making it all colors until end of turn.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, giving Faeburrow Elder +3/+3 until end of turn and untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
